https://applovin.com/en/about.raw_html:
Monetize

We grow businesses profitably

AppLovin empowers people to build businesses bigger than they ever imagined.

Great products win

Performance, not pitches

We invest in making the best possible advertising platform, not in sales presentations.

Built for any size business

Our customers don’t need to be marketing experts. If you have a great product, AppLovin scales it.

The math has to work

For every dollar an advertiser spends, they have to make more on the other side. And advertisers spend over $11B on our platform annually.

Adam Foroughi

Founder & CEO of AppLovin

AppLovin was founded in 2012 by a handful of performance marketers with an $8 domain.

campaign

Over the past 14 years, we've built one of the largest advertising platforms in the world — by doing one thing relentlessly well: helping small businesses become big.

joystick

Early on, we partnered with indie studios and helped them grow into 9- and 10-figure giants. We grew the mobile gaming industry, and AppLovin grew with it.

language

Today, AppLovin powers the vast majority of major mobile games. Now we’re doing for consumer brands what we did for indie game studios — and we're just getting started.

Common questions

    What types of products can I advertise on AppLovin?
    AppLovin Ads supports sales of physical ecommerce products, as well as digital products, subscriptions, and services across web and app businesses.
    What do I need to get started?

    Getting started is easy. For web advertisers, install the AppLovin Pixel through the Shopify App Store or Google Tag Manager. For app advertisers, integrate your MMP. Then set up your campaign and define your goal and budget. Upload your existing creative assets and use AppLovin’s AI ad generation tools to build additional assets. Once you launch, AppLovin Ads automatically targets the right users and optimizes toward your goal.

    What budget do I need to get started?
    You can launch on AppLovin Ads with a budget as low as $10/day. Launch campaigns with a budget that fits your business and scale as you see results.
    Can I use the creatives I'm already running elsewhere?

    Yes. You can upload your existing creative assets, including videos and images, into creative sets on AppLovin Ads.

    For best results, we recommend uploading as many creatives as possible. Greater volume and variety give AppLovin Ads more to evaluate, allowing it to select and show the best-performing ad for each impression.

    Where do AppLovin ads show up?
    Ads appear in a variety of top-rated mobile games, including Subway Surfers, Candy Crush, Sudoku, Solitaire, and Words With Friends.
